title: sorbus aria subsp. longifolia
intro: Sorbus aria subsp. longifolia, commonly known as Whitebeam, is a sub-species of the Whitebeam tree, native to Europe and Western Asia. It is known for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which provide several health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus aria subsp. longifolia include its use as an anti-diarrheal agent, a treatment for fever, and a remedy for respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
